name: Veterinary: pig lower limb CT, CBCT and planar images (Goswami 2020, IEEE DataPort)
what: seven zips, about 205 MB: the CT of a pig lower limb phantom, two CBCTs (with and without soft tissue), 7 C-arm planar projections at different poses in each condition and the registration matrices, from 'A new workflow for image-guided intraoperative electron radiotherapy' (IEEE Access 2020, doi 10.21227/gxpd-d998); not the LevelCheck pig study this record once named, and no spine
level_truth: none; no spine; the pose matrices make it a 2D/3D registration benchmark
status: the owner's future direction of 2026-10-20: expand the workflow into veterinary medicine; the zips sit in spine-program's archive, excluded from the record, and the set is open on IEEE DataPort; the Mendeley canine thoracic set (canine_thoracic_vhs) stands beside it since the sweep of 2026-10-21; the page read on 2026-10-22 says the phantom is a pig lower limb, so the set tunes the registration code and names no level
how_to_get: Download from IEEE DataPort (an IEEE account, no agreement) to Ceph as a job; or restore the seven zips from the archive the record names (spine-program 99_archive/MANIFEST_CODE.md).
